-- Identity providers (OpenID Connect). Apply as a NEW numbered migration after
-- the accounts schema. Every statement is IF NOT EXISTS, so a store that applied
-- an earlier version of this file applies the current one again as its next
-- migration and gains only what it lacks.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_oidc_transactions (
  state_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  binding_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  config_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  payload TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS oa_oidc_transactions_expiry ON oa_oidc_transactions(expires_at);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_oidc_limits (
  bucket TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  count INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
-- One pinned link per configured provider. Linking stores the issuer, JWKS URI,
-- client id, endpoints and allowed algorithms; a changed configuration only
-- records a pending re-link, which the owner completes with a step-up proof.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_identity_providers (
  provider_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  preset TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('linked','unlinked')),
  issuer TEXT NOT NULL,
  client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  jwks_uri TEXT NOT NULL,
  authorization_endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,
  token_endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,
  algorithms TEXT NOT NULL,
  token_auth_method TEXT NOT NULL,
  response_iss INTEGER NOT NULL,
  interface_version TEXT,
  linked_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  pending_issuer TEXT,
  pending_client_id TEXT,
  pending_preset TEXT,
  pending_at INTEGER,
  jwks TEXT,
  jwks_fetched_at INTEGER
);
-- Reachability per configured provider, linked or not. A provider that has
-- failed discovery or JWKS for 5 minutes, or answered 404 or a DNS failure, is
-- hidden from the sign-in page until a later check succeeds.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_identity_provider_health (
  provider_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  failing_since INTEGER,
  hard_failure_at INTEGER,
  checked_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);

migrations.sql:
-- Keep chronology immutable. Only a guarded, active workflow-run erasure may
-- replace its subject link with Base's random label and clear sensitive detail.
DROP TRIGGER crank_audit_append_only;
CREATE TRIGGER crank_audit_append_only BEFORE UPDATE ON crank_audit
WHEN NOT (
 OLD.subject_kind='run' AND NEW.subject_kind IS OLD.subject_kind
 AND NEW.id IS OLD.id AND NEW.at IS OLD.at AND NEW.actor_id IS OLD.actor_id
 AND NEW.action IS OLD.action AND NEW.version_id IS OLD.version_id
 AND NEW.detail_json='{}'
 AND (
  EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM rer_erasure_operations e JOIN crank_authority_guards g
    ON g.id='erase-workflow:'||json_extract(e.subject,'$.id') AND g.ok=1
   WHERE e.entity='workflow-run' AND e.phase='deleting'
    AND NEW.subject_id=e.label
    AND OLD.subject_id IN (json_extract(e.subject,'$.id'),e.label)
  )
  -- Base repeats its audit verification in the separately committed completion
  -- phase. Permit only identical writes to the already anonymized record there.
  OR (NEW.subject_id IS OLD.subject_id AND NEW.detail_json IS OLD.detail_json
   AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM rer_erasure_operations e JOIN rer_erasure_scope s ON s.operation=e.id
     JOIN rer_erasure_guard g ON g.value=1
    WHERE e.entity='workflow-run' AND e.phase IN ('blobs','complete')
     AND e.label=OLD.subject_id AND s.kind='graph' AND s.table_name='crank_wf_runs'
   )
  )
 )
)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'crank_audit_append_only'); END;

-- They survive draft edits, publication, wait/resume and executor restarts.

ALTER TABLE crank_wf_runs ADD COLUMN max_concurrency INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1

 priority=COALESCE((SELECT CASE
  WHEN json_type(graph_json,'$.settings.priority')='integer'

  priority=COALESCE((SELECT CASE
   WHEN json_type(graph_json,'$.settings.priority')='integer'
    AND json_extract(graph_json,'$.settings.priority') BETWEEN -100 AND 100
   THEN json_extract(graph_json,'$.settings.priority') ELSE 0 END
